title: MemoryTextView
description: The text the model receives: a marked data block generated from canonical records, never written by hand and never placed in the instruction section. Lines are `[<core content type>|<epistemic state>|<trust class>(|contested)(|not_current)] <escaped statement>`; `&`, `<`, `>` become `&`, `<`, `>` and CR/LF become one space, so record text cannot close the block. Only active, non-invalidated records are rendered. M-6, M-2, M-14, M-30, INV-14, MD-7 (2), C-22.

trust_class.description: The class shown instead of a number (M-14). Thresholds are PD; the class is an input to the view.
